people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Riblah
people.line: Babylonian headquarters during the conquest of Judah

translations.web: Then they captured the king, and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they passed judgment on him.
translations.bsb: The Chaldeans seized the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah, where they pronounced judgment on him.
translations.kjv: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.
translations.asv: Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.
